source_cause.meaning: Actual metallic-Gamma branch, neutralizing Fermi shift before induced-HXC update, final converged response potential has def subtracted in both collinear spins; checkpoint precedes subtraction.
def(npert) is complex native -deltaN/DOS, symmetrized, independent of spectral finite differences; same scalar corrects charge neutrality.

Fresh path returns from dfpt_kernel then immediately serializes shifted potential and contracts elphel for this same irrep; converged rec_code10 can skip the kernel and must not read stale/uninitialized def.
elphel adds shifted induced potential to complete bare RHS and contracts full ordinary-space matrix; no inverse Fermi shift is added later.

native_definition.branch: (lgauss OR ltetra) AND lgamma, with tetra/noncollinear/USPP/PAW/Hubbard still rejected by this exporter
native_definition.native_screened: dH_KS/du - def(perturbation)*I at the verified metallic-Gamma branch; no shift elsewhere
native_definition.absolute_screened: native_screened + def(perturbation)*I; ordinary NC overlap I, matching same-k/same-spin band basis at Gamma; no k/spin-dependent fitted shift
native_definition.bare: Unchanged complete pre-induced-HXC bare operator, no chemical-potential subtraction

proposed_capture.point: vertex_begin inside native elphel, called directly from solve_linter:296 after dfpt_kernel:256-257 returns with final response and before either bare/screened export. Capture native efermi_shift.def(1:npe), not stdout or FD.
proposed_capture.identity: Bind iq, irrep, imode0, perturbation, q, actual branch flag, full complex native def and existing native pattern columns in one transactional raw file.
proposed_capture.recovery_safety: Converged rec_code10 read_rec can skip dfpt_kernel via solve_linter:176; do NOT assume module def persisted. Conservatively rollback/recompute the interrupted uncommitted current irrep from code2 before launch, preserving unaffected committed irreps; reject rec_code10 capture natively if unreconciled. Completed raw files persist their matching exact def.

schema_cutover.format: CATDFT_NC_VERTEX_V2, old V1 rejected by current decoder, old files/source snapshots retained only as history
schema_cutover.representation: Stream native and reconstructed full complex matrices from the same native array, adding def only to diagonal on output; no new dense matrix allocation/copy. Explicit branch/def metadata disambiguates both operators.
schema_cutover.nonzero_q: Branch false, exact zero def, absolute/native matrices agree everywhere. Offdiagonal Gamma entries and all other band/k/spin entries satisfy exact native+def*identity invariant.
schema_cutover.consumers: Migrate native patch/writer, strict decoder, PH validation/recovery, result schema and all proof producers/comparators. SCREENED_HAMILTONIAN feeds unchanged absolute eigenenergy FD target; SCREENED_NATIVE feeds same-gauge native ordinary/EPA checks.

projection.rule: With native pattern columns U and Cartesian target e, solve U*c=e; project every operator AND scalar def with sum_p c_p*(quantity_p), no extra conjugation. Same coefficients already used by the all-six bare force check.
projection.selection: Fresh current Gamma, original deterministic largest isolated absolute H-x derivative selection applied explicitly to SCREENED_HAMILTONIAN, frozen before all four new displaced outputs; do not repin oldG8 eigenpair.

prospective_acceptance.absolute: Preserve d(epsilon)/du target, signed0.001/0.0005bohr, atol1e-4+rtol.005, gap and halving requirements unchanged.
prospective_acceptance.relative: Separately named d(epsilon-mu)/du versus SCREENED_NATIVE using independently parsed public XML mu, plus reported native-def versus FD-mu diagnostic; never use FD mu to reconstruct exported matrices.
prospective_acceptance.replay: Root registers corrected definition/algebra oracle before new build/execution; new source-bound complete Gamma/nonzero/force/phase/native-agreement/recovery/cache plus four displaced outputs. Source6 unchanged-target clearance reused only at its scope.
